The affected classroom serves 20 students and has its own tables, nap mats, and teaching materials. I've reviewed the draft relocation plan, which places the class in Room B204, keeps medication handling under the regular classroom routine, uses the standard furniture arrangement, and serves lunch in the classroom. Before I sign off on this plan, I'd like to do our routine check-in with facilities, the nurse, special education, and food service to make sure we haven't missed anything. Could each of you share any concerns or considerations from your area?
